title: Crimson Star
content:
Watch the Sun’s atmosphere pulse and flow in extreme UV. Images are from NASA’s Solar Dynamics Observatory and “conformed, repaired, graded, blended, rescaled & retimed” by Seán Doran, whose video work is always incredible.

It would be great to see this in IMAX or some other large screen format, like in the observatory on the ship in Sunshine.

Tags: Sean Doran
author: Jason Kottke
